title: FrostBoat
description: Frost Walker now works with BOAT!
body:
# FrostBoat

A Minecraft (Paper/Spigot) plugin that allows you to use the Frost Walker enchantment in boats.

## Description

FrostBoat extends the functionality of the Frost Walker enchantment, allowing you to freeze the water surface around your boat. When a player is in a boat and wearing boots with the Frost Walker enchantment, the water around the boat will automatically freeze, creating an icy path.

## Features

- ✅ Works with Frost Walker enchantment on boots
- ✅ Freezes the water surface around the boat
- ✅ Effect radius depends on enchantment level (2 + level)
- ✅ Uses frosted ice that melts over time
- ✅ Compatible with Paper/Spigot 1.21+

## How to Use

1. Install the plugin on your server
2. Equip boots with the Frost Walker enchantment
3. Get into a boat
4. As you move in the boat, the water around you will freeze!
